title: Fantastic Tour
text: A terrific and interesting tour of Barcelona! We learned so much about the history of the city and of course the highlights of things to do during our time here. Bosco was terrific and a wealth of knowledge.

title: A Memorable Evening!
text: Carlos was an amazing guide who created a memorable evening for us. His knowledge of the area and history was second to none. We highly recommend this tour and especially Carlos if you are fortunate enough to have him as your guide!

title: Barcelona History and a Flamenco Twist
text: Our evening Barcelona tour and Flamenco with our tour guide Bosco was everything we hoped for. We rambled throughout various historic sites tailored to our interests, enjoyed tapas at 2 taperias, gelati and a Flamenco show. 5 raving stars. Thanks for a wonderful evening. Highly recommend. Great value and a fantastic experience.
author: jnmullings

title: A wonderful tour of Barcelona’s past and present.
text: Our family had a fantastic guide in Jordi.  It was fascinating to learn the history of the gothic quarter while experiencing excellent Catalan tapas cuisine.  Jordi was extremely knowledgeable about Barceleona’s rich past and tradition, and shared architectural secrets and history only a local expert would know.  The flamenco show at the end was also a treat.

title: Great evening in Barcelona old town
text: Martina was excellent guide. We had a good evening together and eat great tapas. I would recommend the tour to get a feeling of Spain.
